noCoordinates: No world coordinates appear in this file: every position is an offset from the farm origin, and the origin itself is never an input.

encoding.byteOrder: big-endian for u16, u32, i16, f32
encoding.file: QFP1 | u8 format | u32 headerLength | header | track
encoding.headerJson: compact UTF-8, keys in the order of the base header (decoders accept any order)
encoding.hashed: programHash = SHA-256 of plainHex bytes (before Deflate and sealing)

walk forward and sprint for 40 ticks, then stop and turn
hotbar select, entity attack press/release, block use press/release, sample, swing
take-from all bone_meal at a collect mark, then put-into all-but-kit

item index beyond the items table (walk_forward has none)

checkerFailures.description: mode not in the closed list
container centre 6.02 blocks from the only anchor stand
container centre 5.02 blocks from the anchor stand: accepted
header nested 17 levels deep (an unknown key holding nested arrays)
an unknown header key is ignored, not an error

recording.checkerPatchNotes: set.path is a dotted path into the walk_forward header; a value starting with '@' names a generated filler: @65_anchors = 65 valid anchors, @257_items, @33_entities, @129_start_steps = that many valid entries; @nest_17 = nested arrays 17 deep. error null = must decode and check clean. Every checker failure is the same error on the plugin side (the plugin re-checks the upload) and in the addon.

anchorRelative.splitRule: rel = floor(offset); stand = offset - rel rounded to 3 decimals; a stand that rounds to 1.000 carries into rel and becomes 0.0
anchorRelative.checkRule: within = 3D distance <= tol; earlyDesync = distance > max(1.0, 3*tol)
anchorRelative.crossRule: accepted when the dimensions are equal and every axis of the block-view difference is at most 1 in absolute value

rules: attack press on an entity or air: one click on the press tick
attack press or hold on a block: a click on every tick of the press
use press: a click on the press tick; use hold: a click every 4 ticks counted from the press tick (or from the first held tick when the track starts mid-hold)
a use hold with an item in HOLD_USE_ITEMS: no clicks, one hold_use_release unsupported entry at the press tick

submit(t) carries the yaw and pitch of tick t itself (no look-ahead, spike 2.1a: the proxy rotates before it clicks); a session refuses to start with unsafe_rotation if botRotateBeforeInteract is false

cases.description: press on an entity: one click on the press tick, carrying that tick's own rotation
hold attack on a block: a click every tick of the hold (block breaking)
press on air: one click (a swing)
a single right click on a block: one click
use held for 10 ticks (press at 0): clicks at 0, 4, 8
press at tick 3, held through 11: clicks at 3, 7, 11
holding a bow: nothing is emitted and hold_use_release is listed
a one-tick right click with a bow is not a hold: one click, not unsupported
no look-ahead (botRotateBeforeInteract is true): the submit carries the click tick's own yaw and pitch, including on the last tick
attack and use pressed on the same tick: both clicks on that tick

farmNames.rule: trimmed 1..32 chars, no section sign, no control characters, fewer than 3 digit characters in total, and no match of the position pattern

fieldNames.note: matched case-insensitively as whole key names at any depth (objects inside arrays too)

stringPattern.note: the pattern is the plugin's ActivityFeed.POSITION, applied to every user string

strings.note: decimal coordinates are NOT matched by the pattern; the log filter must deny this line by source and message prefix, see FARM P4

seal.verifiedBy: qwerte-core 1.1.0 SealTest (vectors produced by an independent Python implementation, cryptography/AESGCM)
seal.description: AES-256-GCM known answers (A9). Same key for every case. fileHex = "QSE1" | kind | keyId | nonce | ciphertext+tag.
seal.swapAndRollback: a program file opened under another farm id, or with the hash of an older program of the same farm, gives seal_failed; the file stays where it is.
